pick_of_the_day.thesis: K3's real disruption isn't the benchmark scores — it's proving that MoE economics can deliver Opus-class intelligence at Sonnet pricing, which means the frontier just became a commodity and the moat is no longer model quality but ecosystem lock-in.

model_literacy.concept: Mixture of Experts (MoE) — Active vs. Total Parameters
model_literacy.relevance: Both K3 (2.8T total, 50B active) and Inkling (975B total, 41B active) launched this week as massive MoE models. Understanding why a 2.8-trillion-parameter model runs at Sonnet-tier cost requires knowing that only a small expert subset activates per token — and that total parameter count is a capacity ceiling, not an inference cost.
